optical_serviceability.value: Vendor-integrated Aura Rx prescription configuration; independent optical service unverified

research_notes.value: Current Chamelo pages sell Aura Rx, establishing a vendor prescription-ordering path. Exact correction/progressive limits, independent reglazing, replacement electronic lenses, regional fulfillment and interchangeability remain unknown. Do not generalize Aura Rx support to Dusk Classic or Music Shield Gen 2.
